name: freenet-gitatlas
description: Git forge for Freenet — browse and publish freenet-git repos without a central server.

scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:wasm -w @freenet-hub/web && npm run gen:hashes -w @freenet-hub/web
scripts.build:website: bash scripts/sync-website-key.sh && npm run build:wasm && VITE_BROWSER_NATIVE=1 npm run build -w @freenet-hub/web
